spec.description: Single-pane operational overview of the centralized log server: stack health, OpenSearch cluster status, Graylog throughput and journal, per-source log flow, disk headroom, and index-set sizes.
Prometheus scrape health per stack component (1 = up, 0 = down).
spec.title: Service Health

spec.description: On-disk primary store size per index set (requires prometheus.indices=true with the log-index filter).
spec.title: Index-Set Size (primaries)

spec.description: OpenSearch cluster health. 0 = green, 1 = yellow, 2 = red (OpenSearch ClusterHealthStatus enum ordinals).
spec.title: OpenSearch Cluster Status

spec.description: Graylog input vs output throughput. Sustained Out < In means the pipeline is falling behind (watch journal).
spec.title: Ingest: In vs Out

spec.description: Logs indexed to pan_os_logs. 0 = source likely dead.
spec.title: PAN-OS Live log rates

spec.description: Logs indexed to watchguard_logs. 0 = source likely dead.
spec.title: WatchGuard Live log rates

spec.description: Messages sitting in the journal not yet written to OpenSearch. Rising = backlog. TUNE thresholds to your steady-state baseline.
spec.title: Journal Backlog (uncommitted)

spec.description: Filesystem usage for the three data vDisks, aligned to OpenSearch watermarks (85/90/95). Snapshot mount uses a regex to match either /data/opensearch-snapshot or /data/opensearch-snapshots (repo spelling is inconsistent — confirm with df -h).
spec.title: Disk Usage - Data vDisks

spec.description: On-disk primary store size per index set (requires prometheus.indices=true with the log-index filter).
spec.title: Index-Set Size (primaries)
